summary: Independently confirmed the automatic batch creation on PDF file selection. Ran isolated browser journey (1 passed in 57.83s) and full shared_v1 regression (118 passed in 102.81s). Frontend compiles cleanly (no ESLint errors for PdfImport.js) and /admin/login renders admin-login-phone-input on preview (no OTP submission attempted). Did a read-only code review of autoBatch/chooseFiles in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/PdfImport.js.
action_items: Consider tightening the auto-batch name derivation: common-prefix stripping only removes trailing [\s_\-.#] but not trailing digits from a broken numeric token. For inputs like ['Silver_Upload_02.pdf','Silver_Upload_03.pdf'] the current base becomes 'Silver Upload 0' (from prefix 'Silver_Upload_0'), so the produced name is 'Silver Upload 0 (2 files) · <date>' instead of the spec's 'Silver Upload (2 files) · <date>'. Single-file case 'Silver_Upload_02.pdf' correctly yields base 'Silver Upload 02'. Extend the trailing-strip regex to also drop a trailing digit-run that follows a separator (e.g. /[\s_\-.#]+\d*$/) or trim to the last word boundary. Note: the shared_v1 browser journey only asserts the single-file 'sample · ' prefix, so this deviation is not caught by the current test.
critical_code_review_comments: autoBatch guard (list.length && !batch && !creating) matches spec (a); metal_type gating /gold/i matches (c); failure path shows setError and finally resets creating (d); chooseFiles clears autoNote and progress before invoking autoBatch (e).

Deviation (b, multi-file): trailing-separator regex does not strip the trailing digit that leaks from a divergent numeric suffix, producing 'Silver Upload 0 (2 files) · <date>' for the spec input pair. Recommend a stronger trim so the multi-file base equals the human-readable common token boundary.
Minor: autoNote is declared after autoBatch uses setAutoNote via closure - works because of hoisted useState, but placing the useState above autoBatch would read more naturally.

Minor: file-input change handler always clears progress/autoNote which is correct for a fresh selection; if a user re-picks the same files (native input fires change) this also correctly resets state.
seed_data_creation: None; the isolated pytest fixtures build their own in-memory canonical state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PdfImport auto-batch flow verified end-to-end via the isolated Playwright journey. The only outstanding observation is a name-derivation edge case for multi-file selections whose diverging suffix is numeric (e.g. Silver_Upload_02/03); the current test only exercises the single-file prefix. Do NOT submit real OTPs on preview (placeholder keys). Never use phone 9999813334.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests. The multi-file name-derivation deviation is a spec-vs-implementation gap in the trailing-separator strip: `.replace(/[\s_\-.#]+$/,'')` leaves a stray digit ('0') that is part of a numeric token split by the divergence of the common prefix.
